# mistershell_report_template (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell report_template by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_report_template" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_report_template" "by_name" {
  name = "report-template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `access_mode` (String) Access mode.
- `ai_summary_enabled` (Boolean) Ai summary enabled.
- `allowed_role_ids` (Dynamic) Allowed role ids.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `created_by_user_id` (Number) Created by user id.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `filters` (Dynamic) Filters.
- `report_type` (String) Report type.
- `ttl_hours` (Number) Ttl hours.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
